title.en: Warmth and professionalism of the kennel team

text.en: Both reviewers within the period single out the staff as the defining strength of the kennels. One long-term client, whose dog has boarded there for fourteen years, says the team treats pets like family and would not consider going elsewhere. The other praises clear, friendly communication and the ease of every drop-off and collection.

q.en: Are dogs happy at Ballygarvan Kennels & Grooming?

a.en: Reviewers describe their dogs as content and enthusiastic about visiting, with one client returning regularly for fourteen years.

q.en: How is communication with the kennel team?

a.en: Clients highlight clear, friendly communication and a smooth, easy experience at drop-off and collection.

q.en: Is this kennel suitable for long-term and repeat clients?

a.en: Yes — at least one reviewer has trusted the kennels with their dog for fourteen years, indicating consistently high satisfaction.
